sources.name: India Code - Central Legislation
sources.owner: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.access_restrictions: Public access under Government of India open data policy; DSpace repository architecture with backend API at backend.indiacode.gov.in.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: X-RateLimit headers observed (500 requests per window). Recommended maximum 1 request per second with backoff.
sources.notes: Primary digital repository for Central Acts and subordinate legislation. Migrated from legacy www.indiacode.nic.in to indiacode.gov.in.

sources.name: Legislative Department Portal
sources.owner: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.access_restrictions: Standard NIC CMS; PDF repository organized by chronological Act number and year.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Conservative rate limit recommended (1 req/2 sec).
sources.notes: Official publisher of Constitution of India and annual Acts of Parliament.

sources.name: The Gazette of India (eGazette)
sources.owner: Directorate of Printing, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
sources.access_restrictions: Search forms require dynamic session state and often display mathematical CAPTCHA for automated querying.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Automated scraping restricted by CAPTCHA; manual or browser-assisted download required for bulk retrieval.
sources.notes: Definitive authoritative legal publication for commencement notifications, statutory orders, and extraordinary gazettes.

sources.name: Department of Consumer Affairs
sources.owner: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
sources.access_restrictions: Public NIC Drupal CMS; direct static PDF links for rules and e-commerce guidelines.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Standard polite crawling (1 request per 2 seconds).
sources.notes: Authoritative ministry portal for Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, Direct Selling Rules, and Mediation Rules.

sources.name: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
sources.owner: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
sources.access_restrictions: Public NIC CMS; static PDF links for Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Personal Data Protection subordinate instruments.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Standard polite crawling (1 request per 2 seconds).
sources.notes: Authoritative portal for Information Technology Rules, Intermediary Guidelines, and DPDP rules.

sources.name: Ministry of Labour and Employment
sources.owner: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
sources.access_restrictions: Public NIC CMS; direct PDF links for Labour Codes, Wage Code rules, and notification circulars.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Standard polite crawling (1 request per 2 seconds).
sources.notes: Authoritative portal for Code on Wages, Industrial Relations, and Occupational Safety rules.

sources.name: Supreme Court of India Official Judgments
sources.access_restrictions: Judgment search portal incorporates rate-limits, session tokens, and occasional CAPTCHA challenges during peak hours.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Automated bulk scraping strictly prohibited; use official e-SCR API where available or browser-assisted review.
sources.notes: Apex court of India. Law declared under Article 141 is binding on all courts. Electronic Supreme Court Reports (e-SCR) provides neutral citations (e.g. 2024 INSC ...).

sources.name: eCourts Services Portal
sources.owner: e-Committee, Supreme Court of India and Department of Justice
sources.access_restrictions: eCourts judgment portal implements mandatory image CAPTCHAs on every search query to prevent automated data extraction.
sources.rate_limit_guidelines: Automated HTTP scraping is blocked by technical CAPTCHA controls. Never bypass CAPTCHA controls.
sources.notes: Unified judgment search for High Courts and District Courts across India.

sources.name: Madras High Court Official Portal
sources.owner: High Court of Judicature at Madras
sources.access_restrictions: Search portal protected by CAPTCHA; certified copies and official judgment orders available under case status.
sources.notes: Jurisdiction over Tamil Nadu and Union Territory of Puducherry.

sources.name: Tamil Nadu Government Gazette
sources.owner: Department of Stationery and Printing, Government of Tamil Nadu
sources.access_restrictions: Publicly browsable archive organized by publication date and issue number.
sources.notes: State gazette for Tamil Nadu Acts, Ordinances, and State statutory rules.

sources.name: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
sources.owner: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC), Department of Consumer Affairs
sources.access_restrictions: Daily orders and final judgments indexed via case number and date. No CAPTCHA on daily causelist/order view.
sources.notes: Apex consumer tribunal established under Section 53 of CPA 2019. Precedents guide State and District Commissions.

sources.name: Competition Commission of India
sources.owner: Competition Commission of India, Ministry of Corporate Affairs
sources.access_restrictions: Public CMS repository with categorized orders under Section 26, Section 27, and combination approvals.
